title: HB307 (2024 General): H.B. 307 Firearm Data Amendments

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Utah) (gun-policy Stage 5, Utah); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Utah text (Amended, ; official copy, https://le.utah.gov/~2024/bills/hbillamd/HB0307S01.pdf (Open States text id 90102288))
provenance.note: 1st Sub. (Buff) H.B. 307, 01-31-24, with House Committee Amendments 2-27-2024 (marked in print); later amendments not in the text read. Reporting starts July 1, 2026 and is due annually April 30; wildlife-agency crimes are excluded. Quoted lines are fragments of the (2)(a) and (3) provisions as printed.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new Utah Code 53-25-102): (i) the number of crimes reported to or investigated by the law enforcement agency in which the law enforcement agency determined that a lost or stolen firearm was used in the commission of the crime, separated by the type of crime; and
Section 1 (new Utah Code 53-25-102): (ii) the number of firearms, separated by category, in the custody of the law enforcement agency that were: (A) returned to the property owner; (B) destroyed; (C) retained in evidence or other storage; (D) transferred to another governmental entity; or (E) submitted to a non-governmental entity for sale or disposal under Section 77-11a-403.
Section 1 (new Utah Code 53-25-102): (c) annually on or before August 1, publish a report of the data described in Subsection (2) on the commission's website.
